newsitem.title: USA: UC'NWIN says appoints Niall Duggan as CEO.
newsitem.headline: UC'NWIN says appoints Niall Duggan as CEO.

text.p: UC'NWIN Systems Corp said Monday it elected Niall Duggan as its chief executive officer and vice chairman of its board of directors.

It said Duggan, known in Europe as a turn-around specialist, is also the chief executive officer of CountyGlen Plc which specializes in acquiring small and medium-sized privately held companies and then restructuring and reorganizing them.
"My primary objective during the next fiscal year," said Duggan, is "moving UC'NWIN into profitability at the earliest opportunity."
UC'NWIN markets and sells software and telecommunications equipment.
